label: Seoul metro ticket machines: service fee on foreign card payments
appliesTo: Foreign-issued card payments at the new Seoul metro ticket machines
why: The convenience is real and it is not free. Stating the fee alongside the capability keeps the guidance honest — a traveller topping up in small amounts pays it every time, and for anyone staying more than a few days a prepaid transport card loaded with cash is still cheaper. It is also the kind of figure that moves quietly once a service is established.

history.note: Announced as an average service fee on overseas card payments at these machines. The issuer's own foreign transaction fee, where the card has one, applies separately on top.
